Tiki Villas
0
Luxury Villas in the Heart of Costa Rica’s Southern Pacific
Discover a boutique adults-only sanctuary (ages 16+) where jungle, ocean, and mindful living meet.
Welcome to the newly reimagined Tiki Villas, an intimate retreat overlooking Costa Rica’s Pacific coast, designed exclusively for guests ages 16 and up. Nestled between rainforest and ocean, our villas blend contemporary design with the rhythms of nature. Whether you’re seeking relaxation, rejuvenation, or adventure, Tiki Villas offers the perfect balance of privacy, comfort, and connection to the wild beauty of Costa Rica.
Our collection of private villas has been thoughtfully designed with a modern tropical aesthetic and luxurious touches. Each villa offers:
Panoramic views of the jungle and ocean
Spacious layouts with king beds and private terraces
Elegant bathrooms inspired by natural elements
Find your sanctuary, whether it’s waking to the sounds of the rainforest or watching the sun set over the Pacific from your balcony.
View fullsize
Accommodations
Executive Suite
Elevated luxury with sweeping ocean and jungle views, the Executive King Suite offers a spacious retreat with a private terrace and refined tropical design.
View fullsize
Premium King Villa
A serene hideaway featuring a king bed, open-air living, and modern comforts, with direct connection to the sights and sounds of the rainforest.
View fullsize
Premium Double Villa
Ideal for friends or family, the Premium Double Villa offers two plush double beds, a private terrace, and generous space to unwind in nature.
View fullsize
Accessible Queen Villa
Thoughtfully designed for comfort and accessibility, this villa features a queen bed, elegant finishes, and step-free access to the best of Tiki Villas.
Dining & Bar
Enjoy fresh, nourishing dishes and handcrafted drinks surrounded by the rainforest, with the Pacific horizon as your backdrop.
Vibrant Costa Rican flavors
Creative wellness-inspired cuisine
Seasonal, locally sourced ingredients
Signature cocktails and fine wines
Tiki Villas is perched above golden beaches of Playa Hermosa, between Uvita and Dominical. Our region known for its natural beauty and vibrant wildlife. Explore:
Whale’s Tail at Marino Ballena National Park
Waterfalls and hidden jungle trails
Surf breaks, snorkeling, and kayaking adventures
A stay at Tiki Villas offers the perfect base to experience Costa Rica’s untouched Southern Pacific coast — from Dominical and Uvita to Ojochal, home to acclaimed dining and boutique stays such as Hotel Three Sixty

Tiki Villas is a beautiful location where you can hear the sounds of the jungle while hearing the crashes of the waves at the same time. Our experience there was magical.
- Sean K.
Wow, what a special spot, a little piece of paradise. The views from the infinity edge pool were incredible. Toucans and other birds flying by made my mornings beautiful.
- Jesse H.
5 out of 5 rating . We hosted our company's executive retreat at Tiki Villas and it was amazing. The staff service and accommodations were perfect.
- Philip R.
Tiki Villas was the best place we stayed in Costa Rica. It was up in the trees and we saw lots of wild life including monkeys from the villas. It had the pool, dining area and lounge all together in one central area so it was very convenient, the perfect size for our group!
- Jackie B.
